brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Palestinian leadership cautioned the public against normalizing what it characterized as systematic Israeli injustice and persecution. The statement linked present conditions to the 1948 displacement of Palestinians and the ongoing prevention of over seven million refugees from returning to or visiting their homeland.

The warning appears to address concerns about Palestinians accommodating prolonged hardship under Israeli rule, according to the wire service account.

title: Palestinian leader warns against accepting Israeli oppression
